-- Typed request and runner/service state. JSON is confined to validation and output.
import Json (Json)
pub type StepDefinition = StepDefinition {
  id: String,
  needs: List(String),
  amount: Int,
  failures: Int
}

pub type Checkpoint = AfterBegin | AfterCall

pub type Command
  = Start(String)
  | Tick(Option(Checkpoint))
  | Advance(Int)
  | Observe
  | Crash
  | Restart
  | Cancel(String)

pub type Workflow = Workflow {
  steps: List(StepDefinition),
  commands: List(Command),
  max_attempts: Int,
  retry_delay: Int
}

pub type StepStatus = Pending | Running | Succeeded | Failed | Blocked | Cancelled deriving (Eq)
pub type RunStatus = Active | RunSucceeded | RunFailed | Cancelling | RunCancelled deriving (Eq)

pub type StepState = StepState {
  id: String,
  status: StepStatus,
  attempts: Int,
  ready_at: Int
}

pub type RunState = RunState {
  id: String,
  status: RunStatus,
  cancel_requested: Bool,
  steps: List(StepState)
}

pub type ActionKey = ActionKey { run_id: String, step_id: String } deriving (Eq)
pub type CallKind = ExecuteCall | LookupCall
pub type CallOutcome = Applied | Replayed | Transient | Found | Missing deriving (Eq)

pub type ServiceCall = ServiceCall {
  key: ActionKey,
  attempt: Int,
  kind: CallKind,
  outcome: CallOutcome,
  worker: Option(String),
  ticket: Option(Int)
}
pub type Effect = Effect { key: ActionKey, amount: Int }
pub type MockService = MockService { calls: List(ServiceCall), effects: List(Effect) }

pub type Snapshot = Snapshot { now: Int, up: Bool, runs: List(RunState) }
pub type Simulator = Simulator {
  now: Int,
  up: Bool,
  runs: List(RunState),
  service: MockService,
  observations: List(Snapshot)
}

pub type Action = Action { run: RunState, step: StepState, definition: StepDefinition }

pub fn time_limit() : Int = 2147483647

-- Checkpoint 2: leased workers, fenced recovery.
pub type LWorker = LWorker { id: String, up: Bool }

pub type LLease = LLease { worker: String, ticket: Int, expires: Int }

pub type LStepState = LStepState {
  id: String,
  status: StepStatus,
  attempts: Int,
  ready_at: Int,
  lease: Option(LLease)
}

pub type LRunStatus = LActive | LSucceeded | LFailed | LCancelling | LCancelled | LFailing deriving (Eq)

pub type LRunState = LRunState {
  id: String,
  status: LRunStatus,
  cancel_requested: Bool,
  steps: List(LStepState)
}

pub type LCommand
  = LStart(String)
  | LAdvance(Int)
  | LObserve
  | LCrash(String)
  | LRestart(String)
  | LClaim(String)
  | LRenew(String, Int)
  | LCall(String, Int)
  | LDeliver(Int)
  | LCancel(String)

pub type LWorkflow = LWorkflow {
  steps: List(StepDefinition),
  commands: List(LCommand),
  max_attempts: Int,
  retry_delay: Int,
  lease_duration: Int,
  workers: List(String)
}

-- Metadata for one lease acquisition: stable identity distinct from the logical action/attempt.
pub type LTicket = LTicket {
  id: Int,
  worker: String,
  run_id: String,
  step_id: String,
  attempt: Int,
  kind: CallKind,
  response: Option(CallOutcome),
  delivered: Bool
}

pub type LSimulator = LSimulator {
  now: Int,
  workers: List(LWorker),
  runs: List(LRunState),
  service: MockService,
  next_ticket: Int,
  tickets: List(LTicket),
  results: List(Json)
}

pub type LAction = LAction { run: LRunState, step: LStepState, definition: StepDefinition, recovery: Bool }

pub fn step_status(status : StepStatus) : String =
  match status of
    Pending => "pending"
    Running => "running"
    Succeeded => "succeeded"
    Failed => "failed"
    Blocked => "blocked"
    Cancelled => "cancelled"

import Data.List (..)
import Data.Foldable (..)
import Data.String (..)
import Data.Result (..)
import Json (..)
import Domain (..)
import Runner (snapshot, leased_snapshot_fields)

pub fn run_status(status : RunStatus) : String =
  match status of
    Active => "active"
    RunSucceeded => "succeeded"
    RunFailed => "failed"
    Cancelling => "cancelling"
    RunCancelled => "cancelled"

fn step_json(step : StepState) : Json =
  JObj([("id", JStr(step.id)), ("status", JStr(step_status(step.status))),
    ("attempts", JInt(step.attempts)), ("ready_at", JInt(step.ready_at))])

fn run_json(run : RunState) : Json =
  JObj([("id", JStr(run.id)), ("status", JStr(run_status(run.status))),
    ("cancel_requested", JBool(run.cancel_requested)), ("steps", JArr(map(step_json, run.steps)))])

fn snapshot_fields(state : Snapshot) : List((String, Json)) =
  [("now", JInt(state.now)), ("up", JBool(state.up)), ("runs", JArr(map(run_json, state.runs)))]

fn snapshot_json(state : Snapshot) : Json = JObj(snapshot_fields(state))

pub fn key_json(key : ActionKey) : Json = JArr([JStr(key.run_id), JStr(key.step_id)])

pub fn call_kind(kind : CallKind) : String =
  match kind of
    ExecuteCall => "execute"
    LookupCall => "lookup"

pub fn call_outcome(outcome : CallOutcome) : String =
  match outcome of
    Applied => "applied"
    Replayed => "replayed"
    Transient => "transient"
    Found => "found"
    Missing => "missing"

fn call_json(call : ServiceCall) : Json =
  JObj([("kind", JStr(call_kind(call.kind))), ("key", key_json(call.key)),
    ("attempt", JInt(call.attempt)), ("outcome", JStr(call_outcome(call.outcome)))])

pub fn effect_json(entry : Effect) : Json =
  JObj([("key", key_json(entry.key)), ("amount", JInt(entry.amount))])

pub fn result_json(sim : Simulator) : Json =
  let final_fields = append(snapshot_fields(snapshot(sim)),
    [("calls", JArr(map(call_json, sim.service.calls))), ("effects", JArr(map(effect_json, sim.service.effects)))])
  JObj([("observations", JArr(map(snapshot_json, sim.observations))), ("final", JObj(final_fields))])

pub fn response_json(result : Result(Simulator, String)) : Json =
  match result of
    Ok(sim) => JObj([("ok", JBool(true)), ("result", result_json(sim))])
    Err(code) => JObj([("ok", JBool(false)), ("error", JObj([("code", JStr(code))]))])

fn opt_str(o : Option(String)) : Json =
  match o of
    Some(s) => JStr(s)
    None => JNull

fn opt_int(o : Option(Int)) : Json =
  match o of
    Some(n) => JInt(n)
    None => JNull

fn call_json_leased(call : ServiceCall) : Json =
  JObj([("worker", opt_str(call.worker)), ("ticket", opt_int(call.ticket)), ("kind", JStr(call_kind(call.kind))),
    ("key", key_json(call.key)), ("attempt", JInt(call.attempt)), ("outcome", JStr(call_outcome(call.outcome)))])

fn leased_final_json(sim : LSimulator) : Json =
  JObj(append(leased_snapshot_fields(sim),
    [("calls", JArr(map(call_json_leased, sim.service.calls))), ("effects", JArr(map(effect_json, sim.service.effects)))]))

pub fn leased_response_json(result : Result(LSimulator, String)) : Json =
  match result of
    Ok(sim) => JObj([("ok", JBool(true)), ("result", JObj([("results", JArr(sim.results)), ("final", leased_final_json(sim))]))])
    Err(code) => JObj([("ok", JBool(false)), ("error", JObj([("code", JStr(code))]))])

import Data.List (..)
import Data.Foldable (..)
import Data.String (..)
import Data.Result (..)
import Json (..)
import Domain (..)

pub fn ensure(valid : Bool, code : String) : Result(Unit, String) =
  if valid then Ok(()) else Err(code)

pub fn unique(xs : List(String)) : Bool =
  match xs of
    Nil => true
    Cons(x, rest) => not(elem(x, rest)) && unique(rest)

pub fn fields(value : Json, required : List(String), optional : List(String)) : Result(List((String, Json)), String) =
  match value of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      let keys = map(\(pair) -> fst(pair), pairs)
      let _ = ensure(unique(keys) && all(\(key) -> elem(key, keys), required)
          && all(\(key) -> elem(key, append(required, optional)), keys), "INVALID_INPUT")?
      Ok(pairs)
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

pub fn has_field(pairs : List((String, Json)), key : String) : Bool =
  match find(\(pair) -> fst(pair) == key, pairs) of
    Some(_) => true
    None => false

pub fn get_field(pairs : List((String, Json)), key : String) : Json =
  match find(\(pair) -> fst(pair) == key, pairs) of
    Some(pair) => snd(pair)
    None => JNull

pub fn optional_field(pairs : List((String, Json)), key : String, default : Json) : Json =
  match find(\(pair) -> fst(pair) == key, pairs) of
    Some(pair) => snd(pair)
    None => default

pub fn integer(value : Json, low : Int, high : Int) : Result(Int, String) =
  match value of
    JInt(n) =>
      let _ = ensure(n >= low && n <= high, "INVALID_INPUT")?
      Ok(n)
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn valid_id_bytes(s : String, i : Int) : Bool =
  if i >= byte_len(s) then true
  else
    let c = byte_at(s, i)
    ((c >= 65 && c <= 90) || (c >= 97 && c <= 122)
      || (c >= 48 && c <= 57) || c == 95 || c == 45) && valid_id_bytes(s, i + 1)

pub fn identifier(value : Json) : Result(String, String) =
  match value of
    JStr(s) =>
      let _ = ensure(byte_len(s) >= 1 && byte_len(s) <= 64 && valid_id_bytes(s, 0), "INVALID_INPUT")?
      Ok(s)
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

pub fn array(value : Json) : Result(List(Json), String) =
  match value of
    JArr(xs) => Ok(xs)
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

pub fn parse_ids(xs : List(Json)) : Result(List(String), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok(Nil)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let name = identifier(x)?
      let names = parse_ids(rest)?
      Ok(Cons(name, names))

pub fn parse_step(raw : Json) : Result(StepDefinition, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["id", "needs", "amount"], ["failures"])?
  let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "id"))?
  let raw_needs = array(get_field(obj, "needs"))?
  let needs = parse_ids(raw_needs)?
  let _ = ensure(unique(needs), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let amount = integer(get_field(obj, "amount"), 1, 1000000)?
  let failures = integer(optional_field(obj, "failures", JInt(0)), 0, 100)?
  Ok(StepDefinition { id = id, needs = needs, amount = amount, failures = failures })

pub fn parse_steps(xs : List(Json)) : Result(List(StepDefinition), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok(Nil)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let step = parse_step(x)?
      let steps = parse_steps(rest)?
      Ok(Cons(step, steps))

fn parse_checkpoint(obj : List((String, Json))) : Result(Option(Checkpoint), String) =
  match find(\(pair) -> fst(pair) == "crash_at", obj) of
    None => Ok(None)
    Some(pair) =>
      match snd(pair) of
        JStr(name) =>
          if name == "after_begin" then Ok(Some(AfterBegin))
          elif name == "after_call" then Ok(Some(AfterCall))
          else Err("INVALID_INPUT")
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn parse_command(raw : Json) : Result(Command, String) =
  match raw of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      match get_field(pairs, "op") of
        JStr(op) =>
          if op == "start" || op == "cancel" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "run"], [])?
            let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "run"))?
            Ok(if op == "start" then Start(id) else Cancel(id))
          elif op == "advance" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "by"], [])?
            let by = integer(get_field(obj, "by"), 0, time_limit())?
            Ok(Advance(by))
          elif op == "tick" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op"], ["crash_at"])?
            let checkpoint = parse_checkpoint(obj)?
            Ok(Tick(checkpoint))
          elif op == "observe" || op == "crash" || op == "restart" then
            let _ = fields(raw, ["op"], [])?
            Ok(if op == "observe" then Observe elif op == "crash" then Crash else Restart)
          else Err("INVALID_INPUT")
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn parse_commands(xs : List(Json)) : Result(List(Command), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok(Nil)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let command = parse_command(x)?
      let commands = parse_commands(rest)?
      Ok(Cons(command, commands))

-- Kahn's algorithm permits forward references while detecting self and multi-step cycles.
fn acyclic(remaining : List(StepDefinition), visited : List(String)) : Bool =
  if is_nil(remaining) then true
  else
    let ready = filter(\(step) -> all(\(dep) -> elem(dep, visited), step.needs), remaining)
    if is_nil(ready) then false
    else
      let seen = append(visited, map(\(step) -> step.id, ready))
      acyclic(filter(\(step) -> not(elem(step.id, seen)), remaining), seen)

pub fn validate_graph(steps : List(StepDefinition)) : Result(Unit, String) =
  let ids = map(\(step) -> step.id, steps)
  let _ = ensure(unique(ids), "DUPLICATE_STEP")?
  let _ = ensure(all(\(step) -> all(\(dep) -> elem(dep, ids), step.needs), steps), "UNKNOWN_DEPENDENCY")?
  ensure(acyclic(steps, []), "DEPENDENCY_CYCLE")

pub fn parse_workflow(raw : Json) : Result(Workflow, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["steps", "commands"], ["max_attempts", "retry_delay"])?
  let raw_steps = array(get_field(obj, "steps"))?
  let _ = ensure(not(is_nil(raw_steps)), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let raw_commands = array(get_field(obj, "commands"))?
  let steps = parse_steps(raw_steps)?
  let commands = parse_commands(raw_commands)?
  let attempts = integer(optional_field(obj, "max_attempts", JInt(3)), 1, 10)?
  let delay = integer(optional_field(obj, "retry_delay", JInt(2)), 1, 1000000)?
  -- No runtime work occurs until every shape/scalar and then the graph is validated.
  let _ = validate_graph(steps)?
  Ok(Workflow { steps = steps, commands = commands, max_attempts = attempts, retry_delay = delay })

fn parse_lcommand(raw : Json) : Result(LCommand, String) =
  match raw of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      match get_field(pairs, "op") of
        JStr(op) =>
          if op == "start" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "run"], [])?
            let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "run"))?
            Ok(LStart(id))
          elif op == "cancel" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "run"], [])?
            let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "run"))?
            Ok(LCancel(id))
          elif op == "advance" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "by"], [])?
            let by = integer(get_field(obj, "by"), 0, time_limit())?
            Ok(LAdvance(by))
          elif op == "observe" then
            let _ = fields(raw, ["op"], [])?
            Ok(LObserve)
          elif op == "crash" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker"], [])?
            let worker = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            Ok(LCrash(worker))
          elif op == "restart" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker"], [])?
            let worker = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            Ok(LRestart(worker))
          elif op == "claim" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker"], [])?
            let worker = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            Ok(LClaim(worker))
          elif op == "renew" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker", "ticket"], [])?
            let worker = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            let ticket = integer(get_field(obj, "ticket"), 1, 2147483647)?
            Ok(LRenew(worker, ticket))
          elif op == "call" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker", "ticket"], [])?
            let worker = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            let ticket = integer(get_field(obj, "ticket"), 1, 2147483647)?
            Ok(LCall(worker, ticket))
          elif op == "deliver" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "ticket"], [])?
            let ticket = integer(get_field(obj, "ticket"), 1, 2147483647)?
            Ok(LDeliver(ticket))
          else Err("INVALID_INPUT")
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn parse_lcommands(xs : List(Json)) : Result(List(LCommand), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok(Nil)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let command = parse_lcommand(x)?
      let commands = parse_lcommands(rest)?
      Ok(Cons(command, commands))

pub fn parse_leased_workflow(raw : Json) : Result(LWorkflow, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["steps", "commands", "workers"], ["max_attempts", "retry_delay", "lease_duration"])?
  let raw_steps = array(get_field(obj, "steps"))?
  let _ = ensure(not(is_nil(raw_steps)), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let raw_commands = array(get_field(obj, "commands"))?
  let _ = ensure(length(raw_commands) <= 2000, "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let raw_workers = array(get_field(obj, "workers"))?
  let _ = ensure(not(is_nil(raw_workers)), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let workers = parse_ids(raw_workers)?
  let _ = ensure(unique(workers), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let steps = parse_steps(raw_steps)?
  let commands = parse_lcommands(raw_commands)?
  let attempts = integer(optional_field(obj, "max_attempts", JInt(3)), 1, 10)?
  let delay = integer(optional_field(obj, "retry_delay", JInt(2)), 1, 1000000)?
  let lease_duration = integer(optional_field(obj, "lease_duration", JInt(5)), 1, 1000000)?
  -- No runtime work occurs until every shape/scalar and then the graph is validated.
  let _ = validate_graph(steps)?
  Ok(LWorkflow { steps = steps, commands = commands, max_attempts = attempts,
    retry_delay = delay, lease_duration = lease_duration, workers = workers })

defs.name: do_call
defs.ty: (Domain.LSimulator, Domain.LWorkflow, String, Int) -> Result((Domain.LSimulator, Json.Json), String)
defs.source:
fn do_call(sim : LSimulator, workflow : LWorkflow, worker : String, ticket_id : Int) : Result((LSimulator, Json), String) =
  let ticket = require_ticket(sim, worker, ticket_id)?
  if not(ticket_current_live(sim, ticket)) then
    Ok((sim, JObj([("outcome", JStr("stale"))])))
  else
    match ticket.response of
      Some(outcome) => Ok((sim, saved_call_json(ticket, outcome)))
      None =>
        let key = ActionKey { run_id = ticket.run_id, step_id = ticket.step_id }
        let (service, outcome) =
          match ticket.kind of
            ExecuteCall =>
              match find_definition(workflow, ticket.step_id) of
                Some(definition) =>
                  execute(sim.service, key, definition.amount, ticket.attempt, definition.failures, Some(worker), Some(ticket.id))
                None => (sim.service, Missing)
            LookupCall => lookup(sim.service, key, ticket.attempt, Some(worker), Some(ticket.id))
        let updated_ticket = LTicket { ..ticket, response = Some(outcome) }
        let updated_tickets = map(\(t) -> if t.id == ticket.id then updated_ticket else t, sim.tickets)
        let updated_sim = LSimulator { ..sim, service = service, tickets = updated_tickets }
        Ok((updated_sim, saved_call_json(updated_ticket, outcome)))

defs.source:
fn apply_lcommand(sim : LSimulator, workflow : LWorkflow, command : LCommand) : Result((LSimulator, Json), String) =
  match command of
    LStart(id) =>
      if any(\(run) -> run.id == id, sim.runs) then Err("DUPLICATE_RUN")
      else
        let run = LRunState { id = id, status = LActive, cancel_requested = false,
          steps = map(\(definition) -> LStepState { id = definition.id, status = Pending, attempts = 0, ready_at = sim.now, lease = None }, workflow.steps) }
        Ok((LSimulator { ..sim, runs = append(sim.runs, [run]) }, JNull))
    LAdvance(by) =>
      let _ = ensure_ok(sim.now + by <= time_limit(), "TIME_OVERFLOW")?
      Ok((LSimulator { ..sim, now = sim.now + by }, JNull))
    LObserve => Ok((sim, observe_json(sim)))
    LCrash(worker) =>
      let _ = ensure_ok(worker_exists(sim.workers, worker), "UNKNOWN_WORKER")?
      let _ = ensure_ok(worker_is_up(sim.workers, worker), "WORKER_DOWN")?
      Ok((set_worker_up(sim, worker, false), JNull))
    LRestart(worker) =>
      let _ = ensure_ok(worker_exists(sim.workers, worker), "UNKNOWN_WORKER")?
      let _ = ensure_ok(not(worker_is_up(sim.workers, worker)), "WORKER_UP")?
      Ok((set_worker_up(sim, worker, true), JNull))
    LClaim(worker) => do_claim(sim, workflow, worker)
    LRenew(worker, ticket) => do_renew(sim, workflow, worker, ticket)
    LCall(worker, ticket) => do_call(sim, workflow, worker, ticket)
    LDeliver(ticket) => do_deliver(sim, workflow, ticket)
    LCancel(id) =>
      match find_run(sim.runs, id) of
        None => Err("UNKNOWN_RUN")
        Some(run) => Ok((replace_lrun(sim, cancel_lrun(run, sim.now)), JNull))

    Cons(command, rest) =>
      let (next_sim, value) = apply_lcommand(sim, workflow, command)?
      let recorded = LSimulator { ..next_sim, results = append(next_sim.results, [value]) }
      run_lcommands(recorded, workflow, rest)

fn parse_step(raw : Json) : Result(StepDefinition, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["id", "needs", "amount"], ["failures"])?
  let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "id"))?
  let raw_needs = array(get_field(obj, "needs"))?
  let needs = parse_ids(raw_needs)?
  let _ = ensure(unique(needs), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let amount = integer(get_field(obj, "amount"), 1, 1000000)?
  let failures = integer(optional_field(obj, "failures", JInt(0)), 0, 100)?
  Ok(StepDefinition { id = id, needs = needs, amount = amount, failures = failures })

fn parse_command(raw : Json) : Result(Command, String) =
  match raw of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      match get_field(pairs, "op") of
        JStr(op) =>
          if op == "start" || op == "cancel" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "run"], [])?
            let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "run"))?
            Ok(if op == "start" then Start(id) else Cancel(id))
          elif op == "advance" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "by"], [])?
            let by = integer(get_field(obj, "by"), 0, time_limit())?
            Ok(Advance(by))
          elif op == "tick" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op"], ["crash_at"])?
            let checkpoint = parse_checkpoint(obj)?
            Ok(Tick(checkpoint))
          elif op == "observe" || op == "crash" || op == "restart" then
            let _ = fields(raw, ["op"], [])?
            Ok(if op == "observe" then Observe elif op == "crash" then Crash else Restart)
          else Err("INVALID_INPUT")
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

      Ok(Cons(command, commands))

fn parse_workflow(raw : Json) : Result(Workflow, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["steps", "commands"], ["max_attempts", "retry_delay"])?
  let raw_steps = array(get_field(obj, "steps"))?
  let _ = ensure(not(is_nil(raw_steps)), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let raw_commands = array(get_field(obj, "commands"))?
  let steps = parse_steps(raw_steps)?
  let commands = parse_commands(raw_commands)?
  let attempts = integer(optional_field(obj, "max_attempts", JInt(3)), 1, 10)?
  let delay = integer(optional_field(obj, "retry_delay", JInt(2)), 1, 1000000)?
  -- No runtime work occurs until every shape/scalar and then the graph is validated.
  let _ = validate_graph(steps)?
  Ok(Workflow { steps = steps, commands = commands, max_attempts = attempts, retry_delay = delay })

defs.name: parse_lcommand
defs.source:
fn parse_lcommand(raw : Json) : Result(LCommand, String) =
  match raw of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      match get_field(pairs, "op") of
        JStr(op) =>
          if op == "start" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "run"], [])?
            let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "run"))?
            Ok(LStart(id))
          elif op == "cancel" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "run"], [])?
            let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "run"))?
            Ok(LCancel(id))
          elif op == "advance" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "by"], [])?
            let by = integer(get_field(obj, "by"), 0, time_limit())?
            Ok(LAdvance(by))
          elif op == "observe" then
            let _ = fields(raw, ["op"], [])?
            Ok(LObserve)
          elif op == "crash" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker"], [])?
            let worker = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            Ok(LCrash(worker))
          elif op == "restart" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker"], [])?
            let worker = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            Ok(LRestart(worker))
          elif op == "claim" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker"], [])?
            let worker = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            Ok(LClaim(worker))
          elif op == "renew" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker", "ticket"], [])?
            let worker = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            let ticket = integer(get_field(obj, "ticket"), 1, 2147483647)?
            Ok(LRenew(worker, ticket))
          elif op == "call" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker", "ticket"], [])?
            let worker = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            let ticket = integer(get_field(obj, "ticket"), 1, 2147483647)?
            Ok(LCall(worker, ticket))
          elif op == "deliver" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "ticket"], [])?
            let ticket = integer(get_field(obj, "ticket"), 1, 2147483647)?
            Ok(LDeliver(ticket))
          else Err("INVALID_INPUT")
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

defs.name: parse_lcommands
defs.source:
fn parse_lcommands(xs : List(Json)) : Result(List(LCommand), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok(Nil)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let command = parse_lcommand(x)?
      let commands = parse_lcommands(rest)?
      Ok(Cons(command, commands))

defs.name: parse_leased_workflow
defs.source:
fn parse_leased_workflow(raw : Json) : Result(LWorkflow, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["steps", "commands", "workers"], ["max_attempts", "retry_delay", "lease_duration"])?
  let raw_steps = array(get_field(obj, "steps"))?
  let _ = ensure(not(is_nil(raw_steps)), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let raw_commands = array(get_field(obj, "commands"))?
  let _ = ensure(length(raw_commands) <= 2000, "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let raw_workers = array(get_field(obj, "workers"))?
  let _ = ensure(not(is_nil(raw_workers)), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let workers = parse_ids(raw_workers)?
  let _ = ensure(unique(workers), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let steps = parse_steps(raw_steps)?
  let commands = parse_lcommands(raw_commands)?
  let attempts = integer(optional_field(obj, "max_attempts", JInt(3)), 1, 10)?
  let delay = integer(optional_field(obj, "retry_delay", JInt(2)), 1, 1000000)?
  let lease_duration = integer(optional_field(obj, "lease_duration", JInt(5)), 1, 1000000)?
  -- No runtime work occurs until every shape/scalar and then the graph is validated.
  let _ = validate_graph(steps)?
  Ok(LWorkflow { steps = steps, commands = commands, max_attempts = attempts,
    retry_delay = delay, lease_duration = lease_duration, workers = workers })

defs.name: error_json
defs.source: fn error_json(code : String) : Json = JObj([("ok", JBool(false)), ("error", JObj([("code", JStr(code))]))])

defs.name: dispatch
defs.source:
fn dispatch(input : Json) : Json =
  match input of
    JObj(input_fields) =>
      if has_field(input_fields, "workers") then
        match parse_leased_workflow(input) of
          Err(code) => error_json(code)
          Ok(workflow) => leased_response_json(simulate_leased(workflow))
      else
        match parse_workflow(input) of
          Err(code) => error_json(code)
          Ok(workflow) => response_json(simulate(workflow))
    _ => error_json("INVALID_INPUT")

defs.name: handle_request
defs.source:
fn handle_request(line : String) : Json =
  match decode_lossy(line) of
    Err(_) => error_json("INVALID_INPUT")
    Ok(JObj(fields)) => dispatch(get_field(fields, "input"))
    Ok(_) => error_json("INVALID_INPUT")

defs.name: main
defs.source: fn main() = println(encode(handle_request(read_line())))
